text_block_list.text:
While discussing training plans with Mejiro Dober
in the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't worry about me... It's just a slight
headache... I took medicine already.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... but a little thing like this is—
Ouch, ow...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Guess this is no time to act tough...
Got it, I won't push myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Guess this is no time to act tough...
Got it, I won't push myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...In exchange, let me rest here for a bit.
I don't want everyone to worry about me."
Even after that, Mejiro Dober continued to be troubled by a headache for quite some time...
